caption: A luger's sled impacts a small snowbank at the edge of the track, causing a slight spray of snow.
positive_analysis:
If the sled's runners graze the snowbank edge, displaced snow lifts into a brief spray.
The rider's forward motion compresses loose snow, ejecting particles upward and backward.
Contact with the bank briefly slows the sled while throwing a plume of snow.
The spray disperses as the sled passes the bank and continues along the track.

The sled moving forward across the groomed track displaces snow into a trailing airborne plume.
Continuous travel down the slope maintains a dynamic spray of kicked-up snow behind the runners.
